source_note: Day 4 compile test set v1 (40 cases). 'expect.sql' and 'expect.parameters' are the exact compiled output reviewed by the developer, not yet approved by a DBA; 'must_contain' are independent structural checks compared case-insensitively. The v0 draft metric used a cross-model dimension ('via'), which the MDL cannot express, so monthly_revenue is now defined over payments.

cases.logical_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers ORDER BY last_name LIMIT 10

expect.sql: WITH m_customers AS (SELECT first_name, last_name FROM ecommerce.customers) SELECT first_name, last_name FROM m_customers AS customers ORDER BY last_name LIMIT 10

cases.logical_sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

expect.sql: WITH m_orders AS (SELECT order_id, status FROM ecommerce.orders) SELECT order_id, status FROM m_orders AS orders WHERE status = 'shipped' LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY region

expect.sql: WITH m_orders AS (SELECT region FROM ecommerce.orders) SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM m_orders AS orders GROUP BY region LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

expect.sql: WITH m_products AS (SELECT name, unit_price FROM ecommerce.products) SELECT name, unit_price FROM m_products AS products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

cases.logical_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers

expect.sql: WITH m_customers AS (SELECT customer_id FROM ecommerce.customers) SELECT customer_id FROM m_customers AS customers LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.first_name, o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

expect.sql: WITH m_orders AS (SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM ecommerce.orders), m_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, first_name FROM ecommerce.customers) SELECT c.first_name, o.order_id FROM m_orders AS o JOIN m_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name

expect.sql: WITH m_order_items AS (SELECT product_id, quantity FROM ecommerce.order_items), m_products AS (SELECT product_id, name FROM ecommerce.products) SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM m_order_items AS oi JOIN m_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT o.order_id, pay.amount FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id

expect.sql: WITH m_payments AS (SELECT order_id, amount FROM ecommerce.payments), m_orders AS (SELECT order_id FROM ecommerce.orders) SELECT o.order_id, pay.amount FROM m_payments AS pay JOIN m_orders AS o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT p.name, c.name AS category FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

expect.sql: WITH m_products AS (SELECT category_id, name FROM ecommerce.products), m_categories AS (SELECT category_id, name FROM ecommerce.categories) SELECT p.name, c.name AS category FROM m_products AS p LEFT JOIN m_categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.email FROM orders o JOIN customers c

expect.sql: WITH m_orders AS (SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM ecommerce.orders), m_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, email FROM ecommerce.customers) SELECT o.order_id, c.email FROM m_orders AS o JOIN m_customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.region

expect.sql: WITH m_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, region FROM ecommerce.customers), m_orders AS (SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM ecommerce.orders), m_order_items AS (SELECT order_id, quantity FROM ecommerce.order_items) SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM m_customers AS c JOIN m_orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN m_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.region LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(line_total) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id

expect.sql: WITH m_order_items AS (SELECT order_id, quantity * unit_price AS line_total FROM ecommerce.order_items) SELECT order_id, SUM(line_total) AS order_total FROM m_order_items AS order_items GROUP BY order_id LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

expect.sql: WITH m_order_items AS (SELECT product_id, quantity * unit_price AS line_total FROM ecommerce.order_items), m_products AS (SELECT product_id, name FROM ecommerce.products) SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM m_order_items AS oi JOIN m_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

cases.logical_sql: SELECT order_month, revenue FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY order_month

expect.sql: WITH m_payments AS (SELECT paid_at, amount FROM ecommerce.payments), metric_monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS order_month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM m_payments AS payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT order_month, revenue FROM metric_monthly_revenue AS monthly_revenue ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

cases.logical_sql: SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE order_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'

expect.sql: WITH m_payments AS (SELECT paid_at, amount FROM ecommerce.payments), metric_monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS order_month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM m_payments AS payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT revenue FROM metric_monthly_revenue AS monthly_revenue WHERE order_month >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
